title: Blitch has been inside several underground facilities

tellings.quote: fire but I've been in several of them

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, says he has been inside several underground military facilities. He tells Michels this as something he saw for himself, saying simply, "I've been in several of them," and if true it would mean such hidden sites exist and he has been inside them.
